identity_silhouette.notes: Each player, regular-enemy, and boss candidate preserves its current family silhouette and role read.

identity_proportions.notes: Logical frame contract and compact gameplay footprint are preserved; the player remains intentionally small.

identity_face_and_head.notes: No humanoid faces were introduced; cockpit, reactor, and aperture landmarks remain role-specific.

identity_surface_and_palette.notes: Current role color relationships are preserved and translated into the approved palette.

identity_signature_features.notes: Pointed, narrow, broad, tall, armored, radial, and spiked signatures remain distinct.

costume_construction.notes: For spacecraft, construction layers and attached modules remain coherent; no unrelated accessories were added.

subject_objects.notes: No separately locked subject objects apply to this sprite set.

placement_and_handedness.notes: No placement-locked accessories apply; all sprites remain centered on the 64x64 anchor.

style_medium_and_rendering.notes: Low-poly hard-surface construction, stepped toon bands, and nearest-neighbor pixel finish are visible.

style_edges_and_shapes.notes: Faceted contours, dark occlusion rims, stepped diagonals, and compact role silhouettes hold at logical size.

style_palette_texture_lighting.notes: Cyan/violet lighting, role-coded emissive cores, sparse dithering, and controlled glow match the approved style anchor.

style_profile_application.notes: The supplied gameplay image transfers rendering language only; its HUD, scene layout, planets, beam, and exact identities are not copied.

background_policy.notes: All versioned runtime strips are RGBA with true transparency outside the isolated spacecraft.

requested_delta.notes: The requested reference-locked style update is applied and wired into the runtime scenes.

next_action: Run the 1280x720 Godot playtest and tune only scale or collision if the live combat read requires it.
